data.why: The app requires the user to upload JPG microscopy/histopathology images to crop, zoom, and adjust; the repo ships no example images, so stock micrographs stand in for a researcher's own data.

goals: Open a microscopy or histopathology image and inspect a specific region of interest at higher zoom
Crop and center the view on a cell or feature of interest using X/Y coordinates
Adjust contrast, brightness, and sharpness to make subtle cellular features visible
Save the refined 500x500 image for reuse in a reproducible pipeline
Record the exact processing parameters (coordinates, zoom, contrast, brightness, sharpness) as JSON for reproducibility
Write a free-text description of the image/annotation and save it alongside the processed image

review.summary: The tree captures what the README says this tool is for: crop and zoom a microscopy image, enhance it, and save the 500x500 image with a description and parameter JSON. The stages are well chosen, the labels are clean, and the evidence I opened holds up. It needs small fixes before filing: Rename Files is mis-described (it is the step that archives a record, not a cosmetic extra), and two not_done claims contradict the code.
